plainTranslation: Clashing values or styles of affection. You want different things from love, or show it in ways the other doesn't read. Failure mode: each feeling unappreciated in their own language. Learn how the other gives and wants love - the clash is workable with translation.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: What you each find lovely doesn't quite match. You love differently, and it can feel like a mismatch. Learn their love language instead of insisting on yours.
tension: The harder part is how fast different taste becomes a story about character. Shallow. Boring. Reckless. Cheap. Once you are quietly assigning those words, every small choice becomes more evidence.
advice: Get curious before you get superior. Ask why it matters to them, and tell the truth about why it matters to you. This eases the moment you stop hearing their preference as a comment on yours.
summaryShort: What you each find lovely doesn't quite match.
